<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5>At <COL FEEB4EFF>Nio Sandplain</COL> I found a mandarin.
On a hot day with the <COL FEEB4EFF>sun</COL> blazing,
it's rare for mandarins to be growing.

<MWT 4>Eating it,
it was soft, juicy and sweet, delicious.

<MWT 4>But the next day, going to savour it,
it had vanished entirely.
Did <COL FEEB4EFF>a Jaggia</COL> eat it...
